dedupe_keys.name: infrabel open data portal belgian rail network punctuality safety and asset datasets

description: Infrabel, the manager of the Belgian railway infrastructure, publishes about a hundred open datasets on its Opendatasoft portal. They include the geographic position of all track segments, main tracks, line sections, operational points, kilometre posts, level crossings and their removal, signal boxes, ETCS deployment, structures by type, platform heights, rail profiles and sleeper types; punctuality by month, train type, station and relation, with real-time punctuality, cancelled trains and delay causes; accidents (common safety indicators), signals passed at danger, traffic volumes in train-kilometres and tonne-kilometres, traction energy use and long-term planning of temporary capacity restrictions. Coverage is national (Belgium). The data are free under CC0 and available to download in the portal's export formats and through its API, and several datasets are updated monthly or daily while others date from 2022. Caveats: many datasets were last modified in 2022, so some series may not be current. The datasets support network models of Belgian rail, analysis of delay causes and disruption, capacity planning with planned possessions and asset exposure to hazards. They complement the ERA Railway System Data Inventory and are related to the Network Rail open data feeds.
name: Infrabel open data portal (Belgian rail network, punctuality, safety and asset datasets)
